scope: Monotone comparative statics and monotone policies: increasing differences and the strong set order; Topkis's theorem (greatest and least maximizers increasing, strict version); finite dynamic programs with optimality proved from scratch; monotone optimal policies and value functions under monotone primitives; monotone kernels induced by monotone policies; the savings problem on an asset grid with i.i.d. income: saving increasing in assets and income for any concave utility, and the household state a monotone Markov chain.
source: Topkis (1978, 1998); Milgrom and Shannon (1994); Stokey and Lucas (1989); Hopenhayn and Prescott (1992); Huggett (1993); Aiyagari (1994).
